profile_scope: FRITZ!Box 7590 (non-AX); 7590 AX requires a separate profile
libc: Freetz uClibc-ng under /usr/lib/freetz; AVM libc is firmware-dependent on newer FRITZ!OS
flash_support: PROFILE-ONLY; no Fritz.Wulf hardware flash validation
recovery_notes: Verify HWRevision 226, FRITZ!OS, kernel and runtime ABI before device-specific installation or recovery; never substitute 7590 AX artifacts.
known_issues: Freetz-NG documents incorrect or stale AVM kernel configurations in some 7590 7.55/7.56 source bundles.
Replace-kernel support is constrained on GRX5/current kernel formats; do not treat module or package support as firmware-flash support.
AVM libc may differ from the separate uClibc-ng runtime used by Freetz; package linking must target the intended runtime explicitly.
The 08.25 firmware is listed by Freetz-NG, but this profile does not assert an 08.25 kernel version without firmware-specific extraction.
